keys.admin.config.server.title: Server Configuration
keys.admin.config.server.subtitle: Changes applied in real time without restart. Persisted in runtime-overrides.json
keys.admin.config.meta.MAX_PLAYERS_PER_GAME.d: Maximum number of players that can join a room.
keys.admin.config.meta.MAX_LOBBIES.label: Max simultaneous lobbies
keys.admin.config.meta.MAX_LOBBIES.desc: Active games at the same time. When the limit is reached, no new rooms can be created.
keys.admin.config.meta.QUESTION_TIME_LIMIT.de: Seconds available to answer. Recommended: 15–60 s.
How often (ms) the server removes inactive games. 3,600,000 ms = 1 hour.
keys.admin.config.meta.BASE_POINTS.label: Base points per correct answer
keys.admin.config.meta.BASE_POINTS.desc: Points awarded for a correct answer regardless of time.
keys.admin.config.meta.MAX_TIME_BONUS.label: Maximum speed bonus
keys.admin.config.meta.MAX_TIME_BONUS.desc: Maximum extra points for fast answers. Set 0 to disable.
keys.admin.config.meta.STREAK_THRESHOLD.label: Streak activation threshold
keys.admin.config.meta.STREAK_THRESHOLD.desc: Aquest paràmetre ara es configura individualment dins de cada joc.
keys.admin.config.meta.STREAK_BONUS_PERCENTAG: Aquest paràmetre ara es configura individualment dins de cada joc.
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_LEVEL.label: Log level
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_MAX_SIZE.label: Max log file size
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_MAX_SIZE.desc: File is rotated when this size is exceeded. Example: 20m = 20 MB.
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_MAX_FILES.label: Log file retention
keys.admin.config.meta.LOG_MAX_FILES.desc: How long logs are kept. Example: 14d = 14 days.
keys.admin.config.meta.RECONNECTION_TIMEOUT.d: Minutes the server keeps a disconnected player's state.
keys.admin.config.meta.INACTIVE_GAME_THRESHOL: Hours of inactivity before a game is cleared from memory.
keys.admin.config.meta.EMPTY_LOBBY_TIMEOUT.de: Minutes until a lobby with no players is automatically destroyed.
keys.admin.config.meta.TOP_PLAYERS_DURING_GAM: How many players are shown in the on-screen ranking.
keys.admin.config.meta.CORS_ORIGIN.label: CORS_ORIGIN (HTTP)
keys.admin.config.meta.CORS_ORIGIN.desc: Comma-separated list of allowed HTTP origins.
keys.admin.config.meta.ALLOWED_ORIGINS.label: ALLOWED_ORIGINS (Socket.IO)
keys.admin.config.meta.ALLOWED_ORIGINS.desc: Comma-separated list of allowed WebSocket origins.
keys.admin.config.meta.BACKUP_SCHEDULE.label: Backup schedule
Days backup files are kept before automatic deletion.
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_HOST.label: SMTP server (host)
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_PORT.label: SMTP port
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_PORT.desc: 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL/TLS, 25 for unencrypted.
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_SECURE.label: Secure connection (SSL/TLS)
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_USER.label: SMTP user
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_USER.desc: Email account used to authenticate and send messages.
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_PASS.label: SMTP password
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_PASS.desc: Password or app token. Stored encrypted, never shown in plain text.
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_FROM.label: Sender address
keys.admin.config.meta.SMTP_FROM.desc: Name and address shown as the sender.
keys.admin.config.meta.CONTACT_TOKEN_SECRET.d: HMAC key for signing contact form anti-bot tokens.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksShellSize.label: Firework size
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksShellSize.desc: Visual size of fireworks on the podium. 0 = small, 16 = huge.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksFinaleMode.desc: Activates burst mode with multiple simultaneous fireworks.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksSimSpeed.label: Simulation speed
Maximum simultaneous fireworks in grand finale.
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksStarWidth.label: Star width
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksSound.label: Sound
keys.admin.config.fw.fireworksSound.desc: Enables sound effects: launch, explosion, crackle and special effects.
keys.admin.config.fireworks.panel_subtitle: Customize the visual spectacle on the final podium
keys.admin.config.fireworks.panel_note: Changes apply automatically on the next final podium. Auto-launch is always active.
